description:
Scope: Planning only; production target lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_imap_live.ex at 71,160,209,313,340,353,359,379,398,498,584. Functional specification: retain connector selection, saved-settings versus routing-error distinction, status-toggle errors, safe mailbox routing defaults, defensive event handling, and secret-safe display. Exact exclusive test path to edit: test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_imap_live_test.exs. No new test/support files, production edits, docs edits, E2E or Git changes planned. Add the following tests BEFORE any implementation (no implementation is presently proposed).

Existing test infrastructure: ZaqWeb.ConnCase with SQL Sandbox; user_fixture plus Accounts.change_password then init_test_session; Phoenix.LiveViewTest.live/render_hook/render_submit/has_element?; insert_imap_channel, insert_smtp_enabled, create_conversation_agent and real IncomingMessageRouting/Repo. Existing NodeRouterDispatchStub delegates Engine events to real Zaq.NodeRouter and Channels calls to controlled results. Existing tests 417-556 already submit blank/malformed assignment keys and malformed mailbox params; confirm fresh coverage mapping before adding redundant examples. Use precise observed UI and persisted results, never private function calls or raw secret assertions. Start with isolated LiveView integration tests on the real route, retaining Engine DB persistence where relevant.

Scenario/branch map:
71: mount with one/two persisted IMAP connectors; render_hook(view, \"select_connector\", %{\"id\" => \"nonexistent\"}) rather than clicking a nonexistent DOM element. Assert \"Connector not found.\" flash and previous selected connector/form URL stays selected, no DB mutation.
160: valid save of existing IMAP settings with a provider_default_agent_id or mailbox_agent_ids; a narrowly scoped router test double delegates snapshot/save and reads to existing stub/real router but returns %Zaq.Event{response: {:error, :routing_denied}} ONLY for :upsert_incoming_message_routing_rules. Assert saved URL/config persists, routing record is absent/unchanged, exact \"IMAP settings saved, but routing update failed\" flash and #save-status-error; do not imply transactional rollback. Ensure save event still carries BO actor and confidential flag; do not blanket-stub router.
209: separately intercept only :email_connector_settings op :save on activate (not mount :snapshot) to return %Zaq.Event{response: {:error, :engine_unavailable}}. With valid persisted disabled connector, click activate; assert \"Failed to update IMAP status.\" flash, error status and enabled flag remains false. Preserve real dispatch for other actions.
313: persisted selected INBOX and an existing real mailbox rule; intercept only :get_incoming_message_routing_rules returning %Zaq.Event{response: {:error, :routing_unavailable}} on mount or connector selection, delegate snapshot and unrelated calls. Assert form still renders and mailbox select shows fallback/blank rather than the stored rule; persisted rule remains unchanged. This is a read-failure fallback, not a permission bypass.
340: send whitespace-only mailbox key with otherwise valid agent choice in a save payload (augment existing 510 test if its blank key is not already covering this line); assert no blank/trimmed-empty scoped rule, valid INBOX rule still persisted and success visible. Existing tests may already exercise exact empty key: recheck fresh coverage before expanding.
353: parse_mailbox_agents maps each entry through sanitize_agent_choice; resulting values are only valid choice or dropped. The next sanitize_mailbox_agents pass cannot receive a nil value through the public save contract. Do not call private helpers or add test-only production seam. Document confirmed unreachable line/exception to reviewer unless a genuine production caller is discovered.
359: same function always receives the map returned by parse_mailbox_agents, including %{} for malformed input; its non-map fallback is unreachable from public save. Existing test 476-508 already proves malformed params safely produce no rule. Document unreachable, avoid duplicative artificial test.
379 and 398: submit valid minimal save params omitting BOTH optional provider_default_agent_id and mailbox_agent_ids (not merely blank values); prefer render_hook(view, \"save\", %{\"imap_config\" => params}) to avoid form serialization auto-inserting the select and hidden inputs. Assert saved configuration succeeds and does not alter preexisting provider and mailbox routing rules (two independent assertions), or no new rules for new connector. If a normal browser form always sends these fields, label this as a wire-contract partial-payload fallback and verify via the public event, not private function calls.
498: defensive malformed dispatch response: only if the existing runtime router injection is a supported, meaningful seam, use a narrow double delegating mount snapshot and all other events but returning a non-%Zaq.Event{} value for :email_connector_settings op :save; save should show \"Failed to save IMAP configuration.\" and #save-status-error with :engine_unavailable, with persisted connector unchanged. This violates the NodeRouter.dispatch contract; do not mock internal NodeRouter merely for numerical coverage if reviewer decides this branch cannot occur in production. Record exception instead.
584: ChannelConfig.token has Zaq.Types.EncryptedString Ecto type; load/1 converts corrupt ciphertext to nil and valid ciphertext to plaintext before current_imap_config/decrypt_token. Existing test 417-473 already mounts bogus token and checks fallback defaults but cannot hit {:error, _} here. Do not mutate encryption config globally, forge a snapshot solely to exercise private branch, or expose secrets; record as unreachable through persisted public flow unless an actual alternate producer of encrypted-looking token is established.

Mocking/isolation: existing module already modifies :notification_imap_node_router_module and :notification_imap_router_module application env and must remain async: false with original value captured/restored via on_exit. Keep fault doubles test-local and match exact event action, request op, destination, BO actor/opts; delegate everything else to NodeRouterDispatchStub/real routing so Engine, Repo, form, authorization and encryption remain real. Existing Mox setup :verify_on_exit! and process-private find_node stub suffice. No external IMAP/network for these scenarios. Avoid Process.sleep and assert_eventually polling; LiveViewTest render calls synchronously expose save/activate/selection, assert UI and persisted DB immediately. If asynchronous runtime sync matters, subscribe/assert event or use existing production completion signal, not sleeps. Distinct users/records per sandbox test; never log/show decrypted passwords. No new production seam, test-only branch, global Mox mode, SQL shared mode, or mock of module under test.

Property assessment: selected routing/default invariants and rejection of malformed keys might warrant a focused ExUnitProperties property when testing the public routing choice validator on a broad input space, but this work is UI integration with a handful of concrete error/fallback branches, and its private normalization clauses 353/359 are provably unreachable; no useful property should be added solely for line coverage. Existing route tests cover concrete malformed values. E2E not needed: no new/reworked feature journey or UX/UI; existing LiveView integration tests suffice, so no UX approval gate issue. Action reuse: not applicable; only test coverage of existing events/operations, no operation changes or new Action/tool/workflow consumer. Documentation: no product/architecture docs to update; record unreachable rationale in issue/coverage handoff, not stale line-number comments in tests.

Validation is parent-owned, NOT run by planner: add focused tests, then run isolated mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_imap_live_test.exs and mix q using Context Mode; parent runs targeted --cover and checks targeted lines/branches against fresh results. Do not run full suite or coveralls in this task. Parent handles later workflow final mix precommit before human approval. Do not weaken existing assertions; if 353/359/584 or contract-only 498 remain missed, record evidence and coverage exceptions instead of faking reachability.

comments.text: Implemented reachable IMAP LiveView scenarios in test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_imap_live_test.exs: unknown connector selection; saved-config/routing failure; activation status-save failure; routing-read fallback preserving stored rule; partial payload leaves provider/mailbox routing unchanged. Focused suite passed: 38 tests, 0 failures. Confirmed coverage exceptions: lines 353/359 remain unreachable through public save because parse_mailbox_agents sanitizes entries to valid choices/drops and always returns a map; line 584 cannot be reached through persisted public flow because EncryptedString load normalizes corrupt ciphertext to nil before decrypt_token. Line 498 intentionally not fabricated: non-%Zaq.Event{} violates NodeRouter.dispatch contract and no meaningful supported runtime seam. Existing malformed payload / blank-key cases remain adequate; no redundant tests added.
